messages:
maria-partnerships: Heads-up: kickstarting a small engineering effort to bootstrap publisher listings across AWS/GCP/Azure with IaC. Goal is a repeatable repo scaffold + checklist so partnerships can hand off artifacts to customers. Thoughts?

jason-cloud: Love it. Suggest a mono-repo with `cloud/*` modules (aws, gcp, azure) and a `shared/` for common manifest generation. Easier to keep templates in sync.

lex-engineering: +1 on shared manifests. We'll need per-cloud manifest transforms though (AWS needs S3 prefix + offer alias; GCP wants contact + product support URL; Azure wants offer ID and plan SKU mapping).

sam-legal: For legal we need: scanned publisher agreement, EULA PDF, company tax/DUNS info, and approved marketing blurb for listing copy. I can prep a safe-phrasing template for "data handling" and "support commitments" that passes Azure compliance.

maria-partnerships: Good — I'll own collecting EULA and the marketing blurb with product marketing. Olivia, can finance confirm DUNS/TIN?

olivia-finance: On it. I'll fetch DUNS/TIN and confirm billing entity we should use for early sandbox listings. ETA tomorrow noon PT.

jason-cloud: Operational question: will Redwood publish under our org or will we provision a customer-specific publisher account? For Phase 1 (internal demos) propose Redwood-owned publisher; Phase 2 we support customer-owned publisher via param-driven TF variables.

lex-engineering: If we use Redwood-owned publisher for demos, add an explicit entitlements CSV so we can track which customer SKU maps to which invoice mapping. For customer-owned flow we'll need a doc describing how to rotate publisher credentials and attach the offer to the customer's tenant.

infra-bot: Created task infra/marketplace/bootstrap #PLAT-9001 assigned to jason-cloud.

jason-cloud: I'll create `infra/marketplace/bootstrap` with: README, modules/aws, modules/gcp, modules/azure, examples/, and a `publisher_manifest_template.json` with placeholders. Will include a `publish-checklist.md` listing required artifacts: EULA_pdf, publisher_id, offer_alias, support_email, billing_sku_map.csv, asset_bucket, manifest.json.

sam-legal: I'll drop the EULA_pdf and compliance blurb into the repo once jason has skeleton. Also: confirm we have a single canonical support URL — that avoids listing mismatches.

maria-partnerships: Action items: jason push skeleton by EOD tomorrow, lex to draft IAM role requirements for each cloud, sam to produce legal text by Thursday, olivia to confirm DUNS/TIN. Follow-up sync Friday 9am PT?

jason-cloud: Works for me. I'll add an example `manifest.json` and a tiny example Terraform snippet in README showing variables to fill.

maria-partnerships: Thanks team. If anyone hits blockers ping #partnerships and tag me. Closing thread for now. :handshake:
